components.heading: Exhausts.
components.text: The discharge into the open air of the exhaust of any steam engine, stationary internal combustion engine, motor boat or motor vehicle except through a muffler or other device which will effectively prevent loud or explosive noises therefrom is unlawful. (Code 1981 § 27-11. Code 1995 § 54-154.)
